question: Which state won the maximum number of bronze medals in the 36th edition of the National Games 2022 of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Maharashtra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra **won the maximum number **of bronze medals** in the **36th edition** of the **National Games 2022 **of India.
 
• The** National Games **are a **biennial multi-sport event** comprising various disciplines, organized by the** Indian Olympic Association (IOA).**
 
• The **36th edition** of the National Games was scheduled to be held in** Goa in 2020 **but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic and was eventually held in** February 2022.**
 
• **Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, and Kerala **were also among the **top-performing states** in the National Games 2022, with **Uttar Pradesh** winning the maximum number of** gold medals** and **Haryana **winning the maximum number of **silver medals.**
 
• Maharashtra's success in the National Games 2022 can be attributed to the** state's strong sporting culture **and** infrastructure, **as well as the efforts of its athletes and coaches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh** won **102 gold medals, 78 silver medals, and 63 bronze medals** in the National Games 2022, making it the **overall champion** of the event.
 
• **Haryana **won **72 silver medals **and **58 bronze medals,** finishing** second i**n the overall medal tally.
 
• **Kerala **won **56 gold medals, 44 silver medals, and 60 bronze medals**, finishing** third i**n the overall medal tally.
 
• These states' performances highlight the importance of investing in **sports infrastructure, training, and development programs** to nurture and support talented athletes.
